::: {#exr-sixteen}
#### Seven functions at $n = 16$

Here $\log_2 n$ is the power to which 2 must be raised to give $n$, so $\log_2 16 = 4$ since $2^4 = 16$,
and $n!$ is the product $1 \cdot 2 \cdots n$.
Find the values at $n = 16$ of

- $1$,
- $\log_2 n$,
- $n$,
- $n \log_2 n$,
- $n^2$,
- $2^n$,
- $n!$,

and put the values in increasing order.

:::
